Football stars announce international retirements after World Cup exits

Several prominent international football players have announced their retirement from the sport following their teams' exits from the FIFA World Cup 2026. Neymar and an unnamed former Manchester City star have retired, while Cristiano Ronaldo has confirmed the current World Cup will be his last. These announcements follow significant matches in the tournament, including Spain's elimination of Portugal and Brazil's exit.
